entities.summary: Wright Massey is an American businessman and entrepreneur most widely known as the vice president of development of Starbucks, the director of design at The Disney Store, and designer of the famous Coca-Cola sign in Times Square. Wright Massey founded [[Brand Architecture, Inc.
